quoted_parts:
By virtue of the authority vested in  
me by section 311 of the Foreign Service  
Act of 1946, 60 Stat. 1002 (22 U. S. C.  
846), and as President of the United  
States, I hereby prescribe the following  
regulations with respect to the reporting  
functions of the Foreign Service of the  
United States:
Section 1. As used in this order, the  
words “foreign data” shall mean any  
data obtained or to be obtained in for­
eign countries, including reports, statis­
tics, and publications.

research_rationale: Partial candidate. The full held original extract was read through the signature. Sections 2-4 impose continuing data collection, maintenance/consultation and prioritization functions; maintaining the statement and standards is not completed by initial preparation. The definition in section 1 includes reports, statistics and publications. No own-term sunset, fixed deadline, automatic completion or termination event appears; resource and practicability limits qualify performance. Signature is June 4, 1951, with no separate activation clause. Section 4 opening is materially damaged in OCR and the original PDF is absent from checked local caches; it is not reconstructed from a nonofficial transcription. Full EO12292 establishes formal revocation effective February 15, 1981, not the February 23 signature date. It does not alone establish the first ending of regulations expressly implementing 1946 Act section 311. The 1980 Act transition and statutory continuity remain unread. Full EO11264 creates separate report-supply duties to personnel boards and limited savings; it does not expressly amend or revive EO10249 foreign-data collection. Bounded named/function searches and numeric leads are preserved with exact file manifests; no final search closure, savings disposition, human certification or canonical publication is asserted. Provisional no status is unchanged.

inventory_reason: Three substantive section units: section 2 data-obtaining duty; section 3 statement/standards/consultation duties; section 4 priority/resource/relative-priority directions. The preamble prescribes these regulations but is not an additional independent duty. Section 1 defines foreign data and qualifies every substantive unit; preserved with the original source. Section 3 lead-in and subdivisions are reunited because the machine draft severed the verb and combined (a)/(b). Full inventory certification is withheld pending the damaged section 4 opening.
